incidents.body: Payment and direct debit orders submitted through a Rabobank PSD2 bank links may incorrectly show the status "File rejected by bank" after the authorization of a PSD2 bank link has been renewed or changes have been made to the services of a Rabobank connection. incidents.body:
It is possible that statements for Payment Batches which have been processed via an Exact PSD2 link for ABN AMRO have been imported twice. This could have happend only once per bank account between September 4th and September 10th. 
The root cause has been identified and measures have been taken to prevent this issue from happening again in the future. 

In order to resolve the issue, you can delete the duplicate statement (that has not yet been matched). For more information on how to delete duplicate statements, you can consult our Support Agent via the question mark icon in the top-right corner of your screen. Our apologies for the inconvenience.
incidents.title: Exact Online – Duplicate transactions via Exact PSD2 bank link for ABN AMRO (NL)

incidents.body:
This issue has been resolved. The transactions from the affected period have now been successfully imported for most customers.
For a small number of customers, the remaining transactions are expected to be imported later today.
If you notice that some historical transactions are still missing tomorrow, you can retrieve them manually.

First, please try selecting "Retrieve Transactions" via "Manage Bank Connection" from your bank account settings in Reeleezee.
If the missing transactions are still not displayed, you can download a CAMT.053 file containing the missing transactions from your online banking environment and import it into Reeleezee via the bank overview.
Our apologies for the inconvenience.
